source_caption:
🎬 Cardboard Boxer (2016)

Cardboard Boxer follows Willie, a lonely homeless man struggling to survive on the streets of Los Angeles while searching for dignity, companionship, and a sense of belonging. With little money and nowhere to call home, Willie spends his days collecting recyclable materials and navigating a world where he is often ignored or mistreated. His difficult life becomes even more complicated when a group of wealthy young men begin paying homeless people to fight each other for their entertainment. Desperate for money, Willie reluctantly participates, exposing himself to humiliation and violence simply to afford basic necessities. However, his outlook begins to change when he discovers a discarded diary belonging to a young girl, whose heartfelt writings provide him with an unexpected emotional connection. As Willie reads her words, he begins reflecting on his own loneliness, lost opportunities, and desire to be understood. Along the way, he develops an unlikely friendship with another homeless man, whose companionship brings moments of humor and humanity into his difficult existence. Through painful experiences, unexpected kindness, and quiet moments of hope, Willie struggles to hold on to his self-respect in a society that often overlooks people living in poverty. Combining emotional performances, realistic storytelling, and powerful social commentary, Cardboard Boxer explores homelessness, loneliness, compassion, human dignity, friendship, and the importance of recognizing the humanity in everyone.

🎭 Genre: Drama

⭐ IMDb: 6.4/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 28m • Not Rated

🎥 Director: Knate Lee

✍️ Writer: Knate Lee

source_details.synopsis: Cardboard Boxer is a 2016 American drama film written and directed by Knate Lee. The film stars Thomas Haden Church, Terrence Howard, Boyd Holbrook, Rhys Wakefield and David Henrie. The story is centered on a lonely homeless man who is offered by a young, upper-class kid to fight fellow down-and-outs for money to video it. The film was released on September 16, 2016, by Well Go USA Entertainment.
